sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT TOP 1 
    v.CYCLE_BEGIN_DATE,
    v.CYCLE_END_DATE,
    v.GRACE_DATE,
    v.SHIP_MASTER_CUSTOMER_ID,
    v.PRODUCT_ID,
    p.PRODUCT_ID AS PRODUCT_ID_FROM_PRODUCT,
    p.subsystem,
    p.LONG_NAME,
    p.SHORT_NAME,
    p.PRODUCT_CODE,
    v.ORDER_DATE,
	v.MODDATE
FROM ORDER_DETAIL v
INNER JOIN PRODUCT p ON v.PRODUCT_ID = p.PRODUCT_ID
WHERE v.CYCLE_BEGIN_DATE IS NOT NULL 
  AND v.CYCLE_END_DATE IS NOT NULL 
  AND v.GRACE_DATE IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
    c1.ID,
    c1.Name,
    c1.MainAreaCode,
    c1.MainPhone,
    c1.WebSite,
    c1.BillingAddressLine1,
    c1.BillingAddressLine2,
    c1.BillingCity,
    c1.BillingState,
    c1.BillingZipCode,
    c1.BillingCountry,
    c1.JoinDate,
    c1.TerminationDate,
    c1.PaidThroughDate,
    c1.CompanyType,
    c1.Established,
    c1.Revenue,
    c1.NumberEmployees,
    c1.TeamMemberCount,
    c1.LeadershipTeamMemberCount,
    c1.DateCreated,
    c1.DateUpdated,
    c1.AlignStatus,
    c1.CoachID,
    c1.IsCoachingCompany,
    c1.AffiliateFromPersonID,
    c1.ExternalProductName,
    c1.ExternalPricePoint,
    c1.ReasonForUsingAlign,
    c1.PreferredManagementFramework,
    c1.AlignBrand,
    c1.ScalingUpExperience,
    c1.ExistingToolsAndNotes,
    c1.EnableAIFeatures,
    GETDATE(),
    GETDATE()
FROM dbo.vwAlign_AI_Coach_Companies__ADF c1
LEFT JOIN dbo.Company c2 ON c1.id = c2.id
WHERE c2.ID IS NULL;
